description: Estimate what one request costs on each live FLOP model, from the gateway's zero-spend estimator. Returns models[] (model, price_per_token, capacity_tpm, blocked, estimate: cost_flop, input_tokens, output_tokens, gflops, latency_blocks, stale). This is the miner's cost, paid from the caller's wallet, and separate from Scout's fee (scout_pricing). Needs no key and spends nothing; can take tens of seconds when the gateway is slow.
name: flop_inference_prices
title: FLOP inference cost per model
